      public NetworkOperator.NetworkBuilder dryRun()
      Marks this create as a dry run: the request is sent with the spec's dryRun=true query parameter ("option to verify that API calls will succeed"; boolean, default false). Nothing is provisioned — create() returns the validated request echoed back by the API with no uuid/href/state (spec example CreateNetworkDryRunResponse).
